topic: Does rotation data augmentation make a small CNN more robust to rotated images on CIFAR-10?

trace.plan: Train two small CNNs on CIFAR-10: one with rotation augmentation (e.g., 15, 30, 45, 60 degrees) and one without. Evaluate both models on the original CIFAR-10 test set and a rotated version of the test set (images rotated by 15, 30, 45, and 60 degrees). Calculate accuracy on both sets to assess the impact of rotation augmentation on robustness. Use Ollama's local language model for any analysis or explanation of results.
